title: Flow
description: Data-driven flow definition. A flow is a DAG of nodes connected by edges, with optional auto-push triggers. Every node is a pure closure; behavior comes from onEnter/onLeave/onError hooks and the edges that connect nodes together.

id.description: Unique flow id. Lowercase snake_case, e.g. `tool_selection`, `backend_editor`.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the flow does.

nodes.description: All nodes in the flow, keyed by node id. Any node may serve as an entry point — the runtime decides which one to push based on the caller or trigger.

edges.description: Directed transitions between nodes. The `when` clause decides which edge fires based on the current frame's most recent event.

triggers.description: Conditions under which the runtime auto-pushes this flow onto the stack. Without triggers, the flow is only callable explicitly.

node.description: A pure closure. No executor — behavior comes from hooks and outgoing edges.

env.description: Per-node runtime environment, scoped to the frame.

available_tools.description: Tool filter applied when this frame is on top of the stack. Each entry is `name` (allow) or `!name` (deny). Effective set = parentScope ∩ filter.

onEnter.description: Hardcoded tool calls executed automatically when this frame is pushed. Used to inject rule files, load context, etc., so the model does not have to do it.

onLeave.description: Hardcoded tool calls executed automatically when this frame is popped.

onError.description: Hardcoded tool calls executed when a hook or nested frame errors out.

hookCall.description: A hardcoded tool invocation the runtime performs automatically on a lifecycle boundary. Static args only — no templating.

tool.description: Name of a tool available at the parent scope (builtin, sub-flow, or MCP tool).

args.description: Fixed argument object passed to the tool.

edgeCondition.description: Condition on the frame's most recent event that determines if this edge fires.

name.description: Tool name whose call fires this edge.

expr.description: Runtime-defined expression on the event payload.

when.description: Runtime phase at which to check the trigger.

triggerMatch.description: Pattern matched against the event payload. All specified fields must match.

path.description: File path glob against args.path, e.g. `backend/**/*.ts`.

flow.description: Flow id match, for on_flow_enter / on_flow_leave.

expr.description: Runtime-defined expression on the event payload.
